Experiences

Three experiences

Tell me about your event and I'll recommend the right fit.

01

The Rounds

Walk-around magic

Magic that moves through the room with me. I fill my pockets with magic and work my way around the event, delivering small but powerful impossibilities to your guests. These are the quick, spontaneous tricks I love most, performed for one small group at a time.

Best for cocktail hours, receptions and dinners where guests stay put and I come to them.

02

The Station

Magic at your leisure

I set up a small table and guests come to me whenever they like, staying for one piece or several. A table lets the magic grow well beyond cards. These are mini shows, not quick tricks. Still up close and hands-on, just a little grander.

Best for longer receptions and open-house style evenings where guests move freely.

03

The Show

The full experience

Forty-five minutes of my strongest material for a seated group. Guests become part of the show, assisting me with the magic and even doing some impossible things themselves.

Best for milestone birthdays, private dinners and corporate evenings.

About

Joshua Stacy

I started doing magic when I was ten. I’ve always loved the idea of an illusion, of bending someone’s perception so they see the world a little differently.

I love it when people gasp and scream and laugh, but my favorite reaction is the quiet one. When someone just stands there and you can tell they know they saw something they shouldn’t have been able to see.

I’m not a clown, and I’m not a guy in gloves and a top hat. I want to sit on your level, share a few things I’ve learned over more than 20 years of study, and give you a moment of impossibility. A short break from reality.
